rules: all uploaded assets bind one exact 40-hex source commit and v0.1.0-alpha.1
release-lock is generated from the exact 11 uploaded standard-built wheels
11 wheel twins must be byte-identical across two clean standard builds
11 unmodified backend sdists must have equivalent normalized path+content manifests across two clean builds
every sdist must rebuild/install to the same InstalledImage identity and plugin-id set as its exact release-lock wheel entry
SPDX 2.3 SBOM must cover all 11 released distributions at the exact package version
spec bundle must contain exactly the five public v1alpha1 JSON Schemas plus a deterministic internal manifest
conformance bundle must contain passing contract, wheel, sdist and sdist-installed-image receipts
payload-manifest hashes the 28 primary assets; SHA256SUMS hashes the other 29 uploaded assets and excludes itself
prepublication SLSA provenance attestations must verify for all 30 uploaded assets against the exact repository/workflow/source commit
prepublication SPDX SBOM attestations must verify for all 11 wheels
immutable releases must be enabled before draft/publish mutation
network timeout or unknown mutation result requires provider-state reconciliation before retry
wrong protected tag, wrong published release or ambiguous provider state is BLOCK
clean post-publication download must rerun sdist-derived InstalledImage/plugin-id parity and exact-wheel canaries before alpha exit
published immutable release is never repaired in place
GitHub-generated source archives are not ordinary uploaded release assets
attestations are provenance evidence, not security certification
